name: get-self
description: Return the authenticated user, their department and their manager.

condition.cypher: MATCH (subject:User {external_id: $token.sub}) WITH subject OPTIONAL MATCH (subject)-[:WORKS_IN]->(department:Department) WITH subject, department OPTIONAL MATCH (subject)-[:REPORTS_TO]->(manager:User) WITH subject, department, manager, $token.act.sub AS agent
